```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("data_preprocessing/common/config.R")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r library set up}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(DelayedMatrixStats)
library(dittoSeq)
library(ggsankey)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(viridis)
library(scuttle)
# Assume `sfe` and `spe` objects are already loaded in your environment

```



```{r load spe}
spe<-readRDS(project_path("external/IMC_AnchorTrans_merged_251030163124.rds"))
sfe<-readRDS(project_path("external/XeniumSfe_FibAnno_251104104458.rds"))
```

```{r z-scores}
# Compute z‑scores from an existing assay (e.g. "asinh")
mu <- rowMeans(assay(spe, "asinh"))
sigma <- rowSds(assay(spe, "asinh"))

assay(spe, "z_scaled") <- sweep(
  sweep(assay(spe, "asinh"), 1, mu, "-"),
  1, sigma, "/"
)

assayNames(spe)
summary(rowMeans(assay(spe, "z_scaled")))
summary(rowSds(assay(spe, "z_scaled")))

```

```{r heatmap}
z<-list("glycolysis"=c(2,30,32,7,15,26),"TCA_cycle"=c(29,24,31,17),"Amino_Acid"=c(8),"Fatty_acid_synthesis"=c(36),
        "Fatty_acid_oxidation"=(34),"Pentose_Pathway"=12,"anabolic_signaling"=c(9),
        "catabolic_signaling"=c(21),"Oxidative_stress"=c(37),
        "hypoxia"=38,"Mitochondrial_biogenesis"=c(22,13,10))


markers_ordered <- names(spe)[do.call(c, z)]

markers_ordered <- intersect(markers_ordered, rownames(spe))

rowData(spe)$use_channel_met_markers<-grepl("Glut1|PKM2|CD98|p_mTOR|NRF2|G6PD|TFAM|LDHA|SDHA|pAMPK|PGC-1a|OGDH|GAPDH|CS|HK1|ATP5A|PFKL1|CPT1a|ACAC|NOX4|HIF1a", rownames(spe)) ## for new spe

stromal_types <- c("stromal_1", "stromal_2", "stromal_3", "stromal_4", 
                   "stromal_5", "stromal_6", "stromal_7", "stromal_8")
cur_spe <- spe[, spe$predicted.celltype %in% stromal_types]

celltype_mean <- aggregateAcrossCells(as(cur_spe[rowData(cur_spe)$use_channel_met_markers,], "SingleCellExperiment"),  
                                              ids = cur_spe$"predicted.celltype", 
                                              statistics = "mean", 
                                              use.assay.type = "z_scaled")
spe_test <- celltype_mean
genes_use <- intersect(markers_ordered, rownames(spe_test))
d<-dittoHeatmap(
  spe_test,
  assay = "z_scaled",
  genes = genes_use,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  heatmap.colors = c(viridis(50), rep("#FDE725FF", 1.5)),
  annot.by = c("predicted.celltype", "ncells")
)

d

```


```{r transfer_predicted_celltype, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

head(colnames(spe))
head(colData(sfe)$KEY)

# Create a lookup dataframe
df_map <- data.frame(
  KEY = colnames(spe),
  predicted.celltype = spe$predicted.celltype,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Align based on shared KEYs
idx <- match(colData(sfe)$KEY, df_map$KEY)

# Transfer the predicted.celltype column
colData(sfe)$predicted.celltype <- df_map$predicted.celltype[idx]
# Check a few transferred entries
head(colData(sfe)$predicted.celltype)

# Count how many matches were successful
sum(!is.na(colData(sfe)$predicted.celltype))
sum(is.na(colData(sfe)$predicted.celltype))

```

```{r sankey plot}
stromal_types <- paste0("stromal_", 1:8)

df1 <- as.data.frame(S4Vectors::as.data.frame(colData(sfe)))[, c("lv3_anno", "predicted.celltype")]
df1 <- df1[df1$predicted.celltype %in% stromal_types &
           !is.na(df1$lv3_anno) & df1$lv3_anno != "", ]

sankey1 <- ggsankey::make_long(df1, lv3_anno, predicted.celltype)

ggplot(sankey1,
       aes(x = x, next_x = next_x,
           node = node, next_node = next_node,
           fill = node, label = node)) +
  geom_sankey(flow.alpha = 0.7, node.color = "grey30") +
  geom_sankey_label(size = 3, color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Sankey 1 – lv3_anno → Predicted Stromal Subclusters",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


```

```{r create new column}
sfe$met_state <- ifelse(sfe$predicted.celltype == "stromal_2", "met_hi",
                 ifelse(sfe$predicted.celltype == "stromal_5", "met_low",
                 ifelse(grepl("^stromal_", sfe$predicted.celltype), "met_int", NA)))

table(sfe$met_state, useNA = "ifany")
```


```{r sankey plot 2}
df2 <- as.data.frame(S4Vectors::as.data.frame(colData(sfe)))[, c("lv3_anno", "met_state")]
df2 <- df2[!is.na(df2$met_state) & !is.na(df2$lv3_anno) & df2$lv3_anno != "", ]

sankey2 <- ggsankey::make_long(df2, lv3_anno, met_state)

ggplot(sankey2,
       aes(x = x, next_x = next_x,
           node = node, next_node = next_node,
           fill = node, label = node)) +
  geom_sankey(flow.alpha = 0.7, node.color = "grey30") +
  geom_sankey_label(size = 3, color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Sankey 2 – lv3_anno → Met State (met_hi / met_low / met_int)",
       x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Met State") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))

```

